title: Music quiz
intro: K/DA, True Damage and HEARTSTEEL. How well do you know the music?

questions.q: Which group's debut single was POP/STARS?
questions.note: POP/STARS is the K/DA debut single from 2018.

questions.q: Which group performs the song GIANTS?
questions.note: GIANTS is a True Damage song.

questions.q: Which of these champions is a member of K/DA?
questions.note: Ahri sings with K/DA, alongside Akali, Evelynn and Kai'Sa.

questions.q: Which champion is part of True Damage?
questions.note: Qiyana is in True Damage with Akali, Ekko, Senna and Yasuo.
Ezreal is one of the members of HEARTSTEEL.

questions.q: Which champion appears in both K/DA and True Damage?
questions.note: Akali is the one champion who shows up in both groups.

questions.q: Which champion joined K/DA as a member with the ALL OUT release?
questions.note: Seraphine was introduced as a K/DA member with ALL OUT.

questions.q: Which of these is a K/DA song?
questions.note: THE BADDEST is K/DA. GIANTS is True Damage and PARANOIA is HEARTSTEEL.
